title: Philly in Flux: Walking Every Street in Philadelphia with the Ricoh GR

mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: most recently, I was walking Passyunk Avenue here. I just covered yesterday.
mentions.locationEvidence: No cross streets spoken. Says 118 photographs, ~9 km, 2.5 hours (0:41-0:45); 'walking around like all these freaking junkyards' / 'abandoned kind of like junkyard area' (1:03-1:13), which suggests the walk included the industrial West Passyunk end, but that is inference. Second mention at 9:18-9:20: 'yesterday I actually walked with my mother in Peschan Gav' (garble of Passyunk Ave).
mentions.notes: Recap video filmed at a desk: photos were made the day before, not on camera. Extent of walk NOT stated; a separate video PASSYUNK_AVE_IN_FLUX_06_06_2026 (wSBKZkSnqwI, no captions) and the project page flux.dantesisofo.com/geotag-catalog/passyunk-ave-in-flux/ would give the real line.
